# DHLM Studio — The World in Numbers
> Real-time global data platform: stock market movers, trending creators, billionaire rankings, cost of living comparisons, and lottery analysis.

## Website
https://dhlm-studio.com

## Main Sections
- /markets — Daily US stock market top gainers with catalysts
- /creators — Fastest growing YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X creators
- /rankings — Global rankings: billionaires, companies, GDP, population, sports
- /rankings/crypto — Live cryptocurrency rankings (CoinGecko)
- /lottery — US Lottery: Powerball & Mega Millions jackpots, results, number generator
- /blog — Data insights blog: markets, rankings, cost of living analysis
- /tools — Free tools: QR code generator, password generator

## Data Coverage
- 200+ cities for cost of living
- 195 countries for GDP/population
- 25+ lottery systems worldwide
- 10+ stock market movers daily
- Top creators across 4 platforms
